name: Consistent alignment edges
rule: Line elements up along a small set of shared edges so the whole page reads as one grid.

leaders.note: Columns and rows define key lines that many objects align to. Text sits on the inner padding edge. Components that share a size scale and inner spacing form a grid on their own.
A baseline grid keeps spacing and alignment consistent. Column, modular and hierarchical grids give content shared lines to snap to, while sizing stays flexible across screen sizes.
